Execute a JavaScript program that orchestrates this server's tools, and return only its result.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "run_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_comments · Private data: validate_json, query_model_graphql, whoami, export_owl, export_rml, transform_schema · Public sink: whoami · Destructive: export_json_ld, get_mixins_and_relation_groups, list_projects, query_model_graphql, search_nodes, export_rml, transform_schema, run_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_comments · Private data: validate_json, query_model_graphql, whoami, export_owl, export_rml, transform_schema · Public sink: whoami · Destructive: export_json_ld, get_mixins_and_relation_groups, list_projects, query_model_graphql, search_nodes, export_rml, transform_schema, run_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
